messages:
anya: quick design check for the prompt-sets regression drawer mock in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/zzz (drawer, bulk-actions, compact-scorecard) keith: looks good. two quick raises: 1) drawer close 'X' is too small on mobile, 2) bulk action checkboxes are easy to mis-tap. marta: Accessibility: checkboxes need larger touch targets and label association. also screen reader reads '0 diffs' as 'zero diffs' we prefer 'No diffs' for clarity. ux-bot: a11y scan: 1 focus visible missing on drawer close, 2 contrast fail for small helper text. Report: /reports/scan-1872001111.pdf anya: copy tweak: change empty state to 'No diffs 1 Run tests or add prompts' (action-first). CTA order: primary = Run tests, secondary = Add prompt set. keith: UX tweak: move bulk actions into sticky header inside drawer, not inline per row. add small confirmation for bulk approve with required reason. shortcut idea: Shift+A to open bulk modal. marta: keyboard: implement roving tabindex for drawer rows and Enter to expand. aria-live for the empty count:
No diffs
eng-frontend: noted. we'll size close button to 40px hit area and move bulk actions to header. will add required reason to bulk approve modal. anya: action items: eng-frontend to implement hit-area + header bulk actions (#UX-4780), marta to paste WCAG contrast suggestions, keith to draft modal copy. I'll update figma comments. :thumbsup:
